critical_code_review_comments: LastSyncedBadge.jsx props design is clean (verb + tone) — secondary tone properly drops border + reduces text size + applies uppercase tracking. Good reuse across /today and /dashboard.
Dashboard.jsx loadAll uses Promise.allSettled for the 4 endpoints — resilient against partial failures.
HorseProfile.jsx edge fades use pointer-events-none + md:hidden — correct (no interaction blocking on desktop where tabs fit without scroll).
Today.jsx filter persistence: sessionStorage init in useState (lazy) prevents hydration mismatch; useEffect writes on every filter change. Clean implementation.

Minor (non-blocking): FounderWalkthrough localStorage key is 'equinesync.walkthrough.seen' (dot-separated) — the main-agent's note suggested 'equine_walkthrough_seen' which does NOT prevent the modal. Testers must use the actual key. Not an app bug; just a doc nit.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Two playwright-specific gotchas worth knowing: (1) FounderWalkthrough modal auto-opens on /dashboard for admins who completed onboarding. The actual localStorage key to suppress it is 'equinesync.walkthrough.seen'='1' (NOT 'equine_walkthrough_seen' as the main-agent note suggested). Set this BEFORE first /dashboard navigation. (2) Even with force=True, playwright clicks on the dashboard-last-synced badge can be hijacked by the modal overlay if it's open. Workaround: page.evaluate(()=>document.querySelector("[data-testid='dashboard-last-synced']").click()) bypasses cleanly and fires the loadAll() callback. Functionality is correct; modal interception is purely a test-harness concern.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found. Initial false-positive on 'badge tap fires no requests' was a playwright modal-overlay click interception, not an app bug. The FounderWalkthrough modal (z-50) was sitting on top of the badge (z-auto in header) because the suppress-modal localStorage key in the main-agent note was wrong. Switching to direct DOM .click() via page.evaluate confirmed loadAll() fires all 4 endpoints in parallel as intended.
